title: vote.ack
description: server → client. Tells one player or spectator what their own ballot currently is. Sent after an accepted vote.cast, when their ballot is emptied (veto, option no longer winnable, runoff), and in snapshots. Needed because tallies may be hidden.

optionId.description: The receiver's current ballot; null when empty.

BallotChange.description: Why the server reports a ballot to its owner.

OptionId.description: Identifier of one option inside a vote round. For PART votes it equals the part id; for CONTRACT votes the contract id; for PILOT votes a PlayerId; for quick votes an upper-case token defined in the vote-kind table (e.g. TEST, SKIP).

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.
